blocks.content:
Legislative Council is the upper house of a bicameral state legislature.

Composition:
• Maximum strength – One-third of Legislative Assembly
• Minimum strength – 40 members

Legislative Council is a permanent body and cannot be dissolved.

items: Frequently tested: Minimum strength of Vidhan Parishad is 40 members, while maximum is 1/3rd of the Legislative Assembly.
Key distinction: Unlike the Legislative Assembly, the Legislative Council is a permanent body and cannot be dissolved.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad) functions as the upper house of a bicameral state legislature.
Maximum strength is capped at one-third of the total strength of the state's Legislative Assembly.
Minimum strength is fixed at 40 members.
It is a permanent body and is not subject to dissolution.
